devtools.inspect.color.convert.description: Convert supplied HEX, RGB, or HSL color text locally; this is not a screen color picker.

devtools.inspect.yaml.to_json.description: Convert one supplied YAML document to JSON locally; duplicate keys use the last value.

devtools.inspect.yaml.from_json.description: Convert supplied JSON text to YAML locally while preserving large integer text.

devtools.inspect.cidr.inspect.description: Calculate IPv4 CIDR network details from pasted text; does not connect to or scan a network.

devtools.inspect.jwt.inspect.description: Decode JWT header and payload locally; does not verify signature, expiry, or trust.

devtools.inspect.unicode.inspect.description: Inspect code points, UTF-8 bytes, and common invisible characters in supplied text.

devtools.inspect.unicode.nfc.description: Normalize supplied text to Unicode NFC; this changes the text representation.

devtools.inspect.unicode.nfkc.description: Normalize supplied text to Unicode NFKC; compatibility normalization may change meaning.

devtools.trace.java.trace.description: Analyze pasted Java printStackTrace text and show exception and frame clues; findings are not confirmed causes.

devtools.trace.django.trace.description: Analyze pasted Python or Django traceback text; paths remain text and the project is not executed.

devtools.text.json.format.description: Format supplied JSON text locally using the plugin's bounded compatibility rules.

devtools.text.json.minify.description: Remove insignificant whitespace from supplied JSON text locally using bounded compatibility rules.

devtools.text.json.validate.description: Validate supplied JSON text against the plugin's duplicate-key, depth, and safe-integer restrictions.

devtools.text.sql.format.description: Format pasted SQL using the generic default dialect; does not connect to a database or validate semantics.

devtools.text.base64.encode.description: Encode supplied UTF-8 text as standard Base64 locally; no file input is read.

devtools.text.base64.decode.description: Decode standard Base64 text locally and return UTF-8 text; no file input is read.

devtools.text.sha256.description: Calculate SHA-256 for supplied UTF-8 text; this does not verify files or establish authenticity.
